basic_info.description: Welcome to classic San Francisco charm in this Marina-style gem where vintage character meets modern updates. With 2 bedrooms, a sunroom, 1 bath, and 1,325 sq ft of inviting space, this home is ready for its next chapter.    The sunlit living room features refinished hardwood floors, a brick fireplace framed by original built-ins, and a stylish new light fixture. The formal dining room includes a built-in buffetperfect for entertaining or relaxing with family and friends.    The kitchen has new flooring, updated lighting, and select new appliances, offering charm and potential to make it your own. Two comfortable bedrooms, a sunroom, and an updated bathroom complete the main level, all freshly painted for a bright, welcoming feel.    Downstairs, a two-car tandem garage offers storage and expansion potentialthink extra living space, a rental unit, or creative studio. The backyard features a covered patio and open space ready for your personal touch.    Located in the heart of the Sunset District near Irving and Noriega, Golden Gate Park, and Ocean Beachwith easy access to 19th Ave, Sunset Blvd, and the MUNI N-Linethis home blends comfort, convenience, and classic San Francisco living.
